result.summary: Identified 2 minor UI and content issues regarding placeholder graphics and a missing icon.

issues.description: Food listings display simplified 2D vector illustrations instead of real food photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace vector artwork with real food photos to improve user engagement.

issues.description: The top-right button contains a red notification indicator but lacks a background icon.
issues.suggestion: Add an appropriate icon, such as a bell or user profile symbol, inside the button.
